purpose: Sentiment and themes of customer reviews, shown as a summary. Advisory only.
method: TF-IDF word (1-2) + character (3-5) n-grams; multinomial logistic regression (sentiment); one-vs-rest logistic regression (themes).
data: data/reviews.psv - 260 student-authored review concepts x 3 languages (see data/PROVENANCE.md).
test_set_note: reviews-v2 re-split the larger dataset, and the test set was scored once, after every choice was fixed by grouped cross-validation. Some of its concepts were also in reviews-v1's test set, which was looked at once before class balancing was added (that choice carries over), so treat small margins with care.
limits: Small synthetic dataset; Setswana and Afrikaans unreviewed. Sarcasm and mixed reviews are hard. The good_quality theme is new (32 concepts). Never used to hide, rank or remove reviews.
